items.title: Mozambique: Government approves support package for Temane power plant project with World Bank financing
items.summary: The Mozambican Government intends to revive the Temane Thermal Power Plant project in Inhambane province, including financing of up to US$65 million (€58.3 million) from the World Bank, reduced fees and an extension of the concession period to 30 years. The measure concerns the Support Package for the Recovery of the Temane Thermal Power Plant… Source
